article.title: Modernisation does not mean capitalism: The Thirty-Eighth Newsletter (2026)
article.author: Vijay Prashad
article.content: For the Global South, development cannot be achieved by imitating the capitalist West; it requires breaking imperialist dependency through the defence of sovereignty, socialist planning, and the transformation of social relations.
